page.overview:
Who is Davias?

Davias is a character of Final Fantasy Adventure. He is a dictator in the town of Jadd. Davias' mother is a Medusa who lives in a cave by the oasis in the desert. He also has the power to change people into animals.

Sumo came to Jadd looking for Amanda. Jadd is ruled by Davias who lives in the mansion up to the northwest of town. The townfolk are not fond of him. Sumo goes to meet him anyway, and is warned by Davias that he better behave while he is in town. He mentions knowing Amanda, and that she went to the Cave of Medusa, and that nobody ever returned from there.

He places a curse on Amanda's brother, Lester, which turnz him into a parrot. After acquiring the tears from the Cave of Medusa, Sumo returns to Jadd and goes to see Davias in his chamber. When Davias is not there, Sumo uses the tears on the parrot and Lester is released from the curse. Lester thanks him, but Sumo breaks the news that Amanda sacrificed herself to save him. He asks if Sumo will help him avenge his sister, and he agrees. The both of them venture deeper into Davias's mansion, searching for Davias himself. They find him on the rooftop and he transforms into a monster, a Mind Flayer, and attacks them.

Before dying, Davias claims that the pendant is no longer in his possession. Garuda flies over Mt. Rocks towards Glaive.
